input.subject: RFx KPC-2026-014: Rosemary COA received, remaining clarifications
input.body:
Dear Prakash,

Thank you for the rosemary leaf extract COA (RM-008). We still need the following before we can evaluate your quote.

Product-specific questions:
1. Glycerin (RM-002): state the minimum order quantity in kg.
2. Glycerin (RM-002): state the total shelf life and the remaining shelf life you guarantee at delivery.
3. Caffeine anhydrous (RM-005): your quote says "one full lot". State the lot size in kg.
4. Caffeine anhydrous (RM-005): state the total shelf life and the remaining shelf life you guarantee at delivery.

Mandatory questionnaire:
5. Safety Data Sheet for each material you quote (RM-002, RM-005, RM-008), and written confirmation that each is suitable for leave-on scalp use under India's Cosmetics Rules, 2020. This is required before we can proceed.
6. Certificate of Analysis for glycerin (RM-002) and caffeine anhydrous (RM-005), showing batch number, manufacturing date and retest date. For the rosemary COA already received, please confirm the batch number, manufacturing date and retest date are shown.
7. Your on-time-in-full (OTIF) rate over the last 12 months, with supporting data. Your reply mentions 99%; please state the figure and how it is measured.
8. Your rejection rate over the last 12 months, the certifications you hold with their expiry dates, and the expected issue date of the renewal certificates.
9. Confirm whether you are the manufacturer or a trader. Name the manufacturer and site, and any second source. Confirm whether you will share delivery and rejection records.

Please reply by 14 November 2026.

Category Manager
Kesavi Personal Care
